confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from a brute-force attempt to a successful login from an unusual IP, followed by unauthorized privilege escalation, cross-departmental data exfiltration, and an attempt to cover tracks by deleting authentication logs.

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attempt: multiple failed login attempts from an unusual IP (23.129.64.222) outside normal working hours.
Successful unauthorized login from the suspicious IP (23.129.64.222) after failed attempts.
Privilege escalation: user_03 elevated their role to admin.
Bulk data exfiltration: multiple sensitive files downloaded, including cross-departmental data (/data/devops/release_notes_982.json).
Anti-forensics: deletion of the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log) to hide activity.

gaps: Verification of whether user_03 was actually traveling or if the account was compromised via credential stuffing.
Confirmation of whether the admin role was reverted after the session.
narrative: An attacker successfully compromised user_03's account after a series of failed login attempts from an external IP. Once logged in, the attacker escalated privileges to admin, exfiltrated multiple files across HR and DevOps departments, and deleted authentication logs to conceal the intrusion.
